final_text:
Root cause: `indent_columns` was only passed to `ReindentFilter` when `reindent` was explicitly enabled, so using it alone silently skipped the filter.

Changed option validation so `indent_columns=True` automatically enables reindentation, preserving the expected `indent_width` behavior. All `tests/test_format.py` tests pass.
